lines: d36: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hannah Guerrero is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d36: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d36: 🕯️ Hannah is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d36: 🕯️ Hannah Guerrero is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d36: What Hannah kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d36: "Hannah's gone." Mateo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hannah." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d36: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Henry blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d36: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d36: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d36: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hannah Guerrero, 36 days. The mantle passes to Henry Anderson.
d36: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Henry Anderson, 40 — a trail crew lead. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Echo Location, Berserker Rage, Dowsing, Green Whisper.
d36: The village's quarrel was with Hannah — and Hannah is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d36: At the grave, Salvatore, Nandi, Pascaline and 5 more speak for Henry — "Hannah trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d36: The fire knew Henry before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
